To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the advanced composite structural concept for pressurized fuselages of the Hybrid Wing Body flight vehicle can be designed and analyzed to provide significant weight savings.
the HWB structural weight can be reduced by about 20% compared to the baseline HWB structural design.
the HWB pressurized fuselages can be designed with advanced composite stiffened shells that have significant weight advantages over the conventional skin stringer construction.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of advanced composite structural concepts for pressurized aircraft fuselages that are based on a box type construction, and the development and verification of analytical models for the structural sizing and design of the fuselage structural components and the overall fuselage.
the development of innovative, advanced structural analysis techniques and the design of lightweight, advanced composite structural concepts for next generation aircraft concepts.
the structural design of the HWB pressurized fuselages and the associated structural weight reduction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the advanced composite stiffened panel concepts offer a viable structural weight reduction potential for the HWB pressurized fuselages.
the advanced stiffened shell structural concepts are very promising for the HWB and other advanced aircraft concepts.
the advanced composite shell concept is the best choice for a pressurized HWBs fuselage structure.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the advanced composite structural design for the pressurized fuselages of the next generation HWB flight vehicles is a promising concept for weight reduction and associated enhancement of aircraft performance.
advanced composite stiffened panels are feasible for HWB pressurized fuselages.
the HWB pressurized fuselages can be significantly lighter than the conventional cylindrical fuselages.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a new approach for structural sizing of advanced composite pressurized fuselsage panels is possible with the use of simple analytical beam and plate theories, which are applicable for the design and sizing of HWB fuselages.
a new class of composite stiffened fuselage structures can provide significant weight savings over conventional designs.
the HWB fuselage can be designed to be significantly lighter than the conventional fuselage, while maintaining the required structural integrity.
